images.caption: 1874 Allardt Map, courtesy of Washington Township Museum of Local History, with dates railroads were completed.  Timeline on the right summarized the events leading up to the birthing of Niles (1866-1870) at MP 29.2.  This eventually led to the Niles Canyon Railway, which runs between Niles (MP 29.2) and Sunol (MP 35.6), Verona (MP 38.3), in the future to Pleasanton (MP 40.6) -- all on the alignment originally built in October 1866 and September 1869 by Chinese laborers.
images.alt: 1874 Allardt Map, courtesy of Washington Township Museum of Local History, with dates railroads were completed. images.caption: Muir Woods National Monument is part of California’s Golden Gate National Recreation Area, north of San Francisco. It’s known for its towering old-growth redwood trees. Trails wind among the trees to Cathedral Grove and Bohemian Grove, and along Redwood Creek. The Ben Johnson and Dipsea trails climb a hillside for views of the treetops, the Pacific Ocean and Mount Tamalpais in adjacent Mount Tamalpais State Park.

images.caption:
Sobrante Ridge Regional Preserve, Richmond, Contra Costa County, California
Explored 9/05/19, Positions 13 - 15

As I walked the Sobrante Ridge Trail this morning I looked up and saw this bobcat sitting in the grass and watching me. As long as I didn't move, it just stayed still and stared. Every time I took a few steps down the trail, it would act like it was thinking of leaving, but as soon as I stopped walking it would sit back down and continue to stare at me. Finally, it had enough of me and slowly walked away. Definitely a first for me.
